Investec Asset Management LTD Upped Its Itron (ITRI) Stake; As Sanofi (SNY) Share Price Declined, Shareholder Northern Trust Trimmed Position by $3.11 Million
May 22, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Northern Trust Corp decreased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 3.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northern Trust Corp sold 72,269 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.19 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $94.29M, down from 2.26 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northern Trust Corp who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $96.63B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.23% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $38.79. About 1.13 million shares traded. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
Investec Asset Management Ltd increased its stake in Itron Inc (ITRI) by 76.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
